title: Neon Tree of Kisses
description: A glowing spherical orb mounted on a black and gold pedestal contains a surreal glowing tree with neon yellow and pink branches. Multiple stylized lips in bright pink and purple float among the branches against a painted sky background with a winding path and fallen petals below.
prompt: A luminous transparent sphere on a pedestal contains a glowing tree with bright neon yellow branches stretching across a painted sunset sky. Stylized floating lips in vibrant pink and purple drift among the branches. A winding golden path covered in fallen petals runs through the base of the orb. Dreamy surreal atmosphere with bioluminescent effects and sparkling light particles.
